name: io.github.jackson-cmd/zeus-options-terminal
title: ZEUS Terminal
description: Self-hosted options trading terminal: positions and Greeks, risk, paper trading, news, journal

packageArguments.name: --port
packageArguments.description: Port of the ZEUS page; the MCP endpoint is /mcp on the same port

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the page and /mcp on this computer only; ZEUS has no login

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Volume for settings, trades and caches

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Answer MCP over HTTP from this computer (otherwise only through docker exec)
